raw:

  where match
    relation "join"
    role subject "Oisín and Maeve"
    role object "the chess club at Rathmines Library"
    polarity affirmed
  end

@q2 query
  where match
    relation "be"
    role subject "the €20 fee"
    role object ?rate
    polarity affirmed
  end
